task: Determine whether source-deleted ABI-v10 execution of bytes.from_range requires a borrowed Range to cross the native crate boundary.
observation: The generated source-free consumer specializes from_range locally and passes its FileIO borrowed Range as &Range to that local specialization. The body calls the provider's exported is_byte symbol, but the borrowed Range itself does not cross into provider native code. This was confirmed from the generated app.rs function signature and the call site.
impact: Avoided an unnecessary borrowed-Range ABI redesign; the remaining ownership check is the existing local borrow lifetime around the owner close, while the returned Vector is owned.

resolution.summary: The native specialization and borrowed argument are generated in the consumer crate; only the concrete is_byte dependency call crosses to provider native code.
